explicit_option_precedence.outcome: Use ordinary object spreads: later own values including undefined shadow prior values, omission inherits, explicit false overrides booleans, and own undefined can disable copied callbacks/use an ordinary default. Keep callback-null and autoValidate-null specific existing errors and typed exclusion; do not emulate jQuery undefined merging.
explicit_option_precedence.remaining: No runtime global registry, implicit merge policy or new validation. Wider global/live configuration and wrapper parity remain required.

explicit_nested_configuration.outcome: Merge parse/render/format/validate/messages maps explicitly. Merge fields by map and individual FieldRules kind; tuple lists replace in order and [] clears a kind. Preserve shared settings/arguments and keep Rows/functions/DOM ownership explicit without cloning/global mutation.
explicit_nested_configuration.remaining: Mutable/hot catalogs, embedded Grid/List inheritance and all broader configuration/source equivalence remain required.

application_callback_recipes.outcome: Capture local/shared functions and plain-call the same context/phase. A value recipe forwards intermediate thenables to existing Form handling, sends effective local-or-input to shared, preserves local replacement on shared undefined and preserves all-undefined as undefined. False/null/zero/empty string remain values. Whole exact-false can skip shared without veto; legacy after-value original-input/false-tail is a separate explicit recipe.
application_callback_recipes.remaining: Recipes are ordinary application functions, not framework-managed layers. Temporary intermediate values are not individually validated; global-wrapper/source equivalence stays open.

callback_unit_lifetime_and_failure.outcome: Treat each composed function as one existing callback unit. Native/current/source/disposal checks run after its outer return; app subcall tails are not automatically canceled. Preserve normal and stale/disposed value thenable handling/draining, whole thenable handling, thrown errors and final raw/display/source separation.
callback_unit_lifetime_and_failure.remaining: No per-layer lifetime/validation promise or generic composition engine is inferred. Existing defaults/unbind/rescan, choice checks and Rows originals remain under their current owners.

real_cvc_and_installed.outcome: Use one typed module-level employee preset for the existing company-email rule/salary parser across independent CVC instances, final instance Rows and meaningful local onBind selected-label behavior with explicit null cleanup. Add exact-package JS/TS/browser witnesses plus native-owner rescan documentation correction.
